decks.notes: The deck aims to generate massive amounts of mana quickly, using artifact ramp like Mana Vault and Moxen, as well as Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy. It then utilizes cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Phyrexian Metamorph to draw through the deck and generate more mana. The end goal is to assemble the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo to take extra turns and win the game. Karn, the Great Creator can also be used to fetch key artifacts from the sideboard, providing additional flexibility and ways to disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate mana quickly and efficiently, allowing for explosive plays and setting up powerful combo interactions. By utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to bounce multiple artifacts back to hand and draw cards, the deck can generate immense value and set up game-winning plays. With cards like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to provide additional mana acceleration, along with key pieces like Time Vault and Tinker to assemble game-winning combos, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace opponents through the power of artifact synergy and combo interactions.

The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo involving Coveted Jewel, Paradoxical Outcome, and various artifact accelerants like Mishra's Workshop and  Mana Crypt. The goal is to generate a substantial amount of mana and card advantage from Coveted Jewel and Paradoxical Outcome, while also controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will. The inclusion of cards like Tinker, Time Vault, and Mana Vault provide alternative win conditions and paths to victory. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through fast and explosive plays while maintaining control and consistency.

The deck focuses on using the powerful Doomsday card to set up a winning combination of cards, such as Thassa's Oracle, in order to win the game in a single turn. It includes various tools like cantrips, counterspells, and fast mana sources to efficiently dig for and cast Doomsday. The deck aims to assemble its key pieces quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and disruptive cards. Timing and sequencing of spells are crucial in order to execute the combo successfully and win the game.

This deck focuses on using efficient control spells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Psychic Frog and Orcish Bowmasters to take control of the game. The deck utilizes powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage and tempo. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recursion of key cards from the graveyard, adding resilience and versatility to the control strategy. The deck aims to control the game through disruption, card advantage, and creature threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing Doomsday to set up a winning combination using cards like Street Wraith, Thassa's Oracle, and Demonic Consultation to manipulate the library and win the game in a quick and efficient manner. The deck is heavily reliant on powerful card draw spells and can quickly assemble the necessary pieces to combo off and win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond. Additionally, the deck includes a strong counter package with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Dredge combo deck utilizes cards like Stinkweed Imp, Narcomoeba, and Creeping Chill to fill up the graveyard quickly and bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Ichorid. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo. The use of Bazaar of Baghdad allows for efficient graveyard filling, while cards like Noxious Revival and Grief provide additional graveyard manipulation and disruption. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with an army of creatures from the graveyard.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Underworld Breach along with cards like Brain Freeze, Hullbreacher, and Wheel of Fortune to generate a massive storm count and mill the opponent out in a single turn. It utilizes powerful mana acceleration in the form of Black Lotus, Moxen, and Tolarian Academy to quickly cast its key spells and disrupt the opponent with counters like Force of Will and Pyroblast. The deck also includes various tutors and card draw spells to help find the combo pieces and protect its game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with cards like Force of Will, Mental Misstep, and Spell Pierce while also utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly put powerful creatures into play. By consistently playing threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Oko, Thief of Crowns, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Show and Tell and Flash allows for alternative ways to cheat creatures into play. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to take control of the game and dictate the pace.

The deck focuses on assembling the cards needed to cast Doomsday, a powerful combo spell that allows the player to stack their deck in a way that guarantees a win condition. The key strategy involves using cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly, alongside card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Ponder to find the necessary pieces. Thassa's Oracle is a key win condition, as it allows the player to win the game immediately after casting Doomsday and stacking their deck in the right order. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, aiming to win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to react.

This deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to generate card advantage and mana acceleration, allowing the player to chain spells together to create explosive turns. By efficiently cycling through artifacts and drawing cards with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Paradoxical Outcome, the deck aims to set up a game-winning combo with cards like Tolarian Academy and Black Lotus to generate infinite mana and draw the entire deck. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional flexibility and recursion for key pieces of the combo.

The deck focuses on using artifacts like Paradoxical Outcome and Coveted Jewel to generate a lot of mana and card advantage, while also using cards like Manifold Key and Tinker to assemble powerful combos such as Time Vault. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to control the opponent's plays. The deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful artifacts and disruptive spells.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro - Merfolk deck focuses on early game aggression and disruption, utilizing powerful cards like Force of Will, Hullbreacher, and Thieving Skydiver to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Merrow Reejerey and Floodpits Drowner to pressure the opponent and apply consistent pressure. With a strong mana base including Moxen and Cavern of Souls, this deck aims to quickly establish board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy while also utilizing hatebear creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex slow down the opponent's spells, while Anointed Peacekeeper and White Plume Adventurer provide aggressive creatures. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen for mana acceleration. Additionally, cards like March of Otherworldly Light and The One Ring offer additional value and versatility. The mana base is streamlined with Cavern of Souls and Wasteland to ensure consistent casting of spells.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful and efficient spells like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Fatal Push to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Strip Mine and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Lurrus of the Dream-Den acts as a companion, providing additional value by allowing the player to cast cheap spells from the graveyard. Overall, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent through a combination of card advantage and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces, mainly Underworld Breach, to create a powerful engine that allows for explosive plays and generates immense value. It aims to quickly draw through the deck using cards like Ancestral Recall and Ponder, as well as efficiently tutor for key pieces with cards like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor. The synergy between cards like Hullbreacher and Wheel of Fortune disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also providing additional advantage for the player. The deck is designed to win the game in a fast and efficient manner through its combo potential and powerful interaction.
